package.description: Keep your PC awake when it matters

en-US.description: Keep your PC awake when it matters
en-US.longDescription: Lightweight Windows app that prevents your PC from sleeping automatically when AI coding tools are working, when specific apps are running, or manually on demand. Includes smart hook-based integration with Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex, plus process-based triggers for Aider and Ollama. Launches on startup by default.
en-US.name: Insomnia
